segments.title: July
segments.text: Hello Kenkere House! July. The monsoon is here to test everyone's willpower. Our theme is Book the Studio plus Rain Check. We bring groups in together, make it easy to come back after the summer, and take the guilt out of rainy cancellations. The plan, thankfully, brought an umbrella.

segments.title: ₹12.48L
segments.text: So, the number. Our July target for Kenkere House is 12.5 lakh rupees. That's 15 per cent above last July. We're growing, and the plan knows exactly how.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 6.62 lakh rupees. That's 5 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 4.24 lakh, everything else 87,400, and comebacks 74,900. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 63 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 936 leads, 337 trials, and 63 buyers, with about 19 per cent of trials converting. Roughly one in five trials becomes a member. Our job is to make it one in four.

Here's where the offers come in. Four offers carry 3.61 lakh rupees, which is 29 per cent of our target. The rest comes from full-price sales, so the offers are a boost, not a crutch. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Kitty Party, But Make It Cardio
segments.text: First up, Kitty Party, But Make It Cardio. Book out the studio for up to twelve friends, your playlist, our instructor. Every first-timer in the room then gets three classes for the price of two. The plan is 3 buyers at about 15,000, so 45,000 rupees.
segments.notes: Anyone booking the studio for a private group of up to 12.

segments.title: Shy Girl Starter Pack
segments.text: Next, for the nervous newcomer, the Shy Girl Starter Pack. Start with a thirty-minute private, then join class with a trainer who already knows your name. Part of the price comes off the first month. The plan is 4 buyers at about 11,700, so 46,600 rupees.

segments.title: Gone With the Wind, Back With the Rain
segments.text: Then, for lapsed members, Gone With the Wind, Back With the Rain. Fifteen per cent off to return, two extra freezes for flooded days, and a lane in The Amazing Race. The plan is 9 buyers at about 12,400, so 1.12 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Rain Check (Literally)
segments.text: And finally, for renewals, Rain Check, literally. Renew in July for ten per cent off and three Rain Check tokens, with classes credited back on red-alert days. Monsoon happens. Late-cancel fees don't have to. The plan is 12 buyers at about 13,100, so 1.58 lakh rupees.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, corporate and kitty party bookings open. Week two, we call everyone who left in the summer heat. Week three, the Rain Check renewal does the heavy lifting. Week four, returning members sign up for The Amazing Race.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's July at Kenkere House. 12.5 lakh rupees, four offers, and 63 buyers to welcome. It's raining offers. Hallelujah.
